# greeter

A tiny greeting library.

## Usage

```python
from greeter import greet
print(greet("world"))
```
files.greeter.py:
def greet(name, punctuation="!"):
    """Return a friendly greeting."""
    name = name.strip() or "there"
    return f"Hello, {name}{punctuation}"
